caption: The drawing features a single blue dress as the main subject, centered and occupying most of the composition. The dress has a wide, full skirt and long sleeves with flared cuffs. The fabric displays horizontal stripes in varying shades of blue and white, giving it a textured appearance. The bodice is fitted with a pointed waist, and the neckline is adorned with a dark, possibly black, lace trim and a decorative collar extending over the shoulders. There is a frilled trim along the shawl-like collar and at the ends of the sleeves. To the upper right of the dress, there is a smaller line sketch of the same garment, providing a back view in simple, uncolored pencil or ink outlines. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist’s name "Lina Winterly" is written near the bottom right.
title: Promenade Dress
